title: Roveia flying testimonials (v2)
description: A centred 70px heading with a blue second line, pinned while white quote cards (blue quote mark, 16px quote, grey name, small video slot, a soft coloured glow in one corner, a soft shadow) fly across from right to left one after another, turning from +10° to −10° on a gentle arc. On phones the cards stack under the heading and rise in.
notes: desktop (≥1024px): a window-tall stage pinned inside a 680svh wrapper; CSS scroll-driven, no JavaScript
without scroll-driven animation support the cards simply stack under the heading
corner glow per card: highlight (peach), primary or muted
